methods.frozen: Frozen source behavior-cloning policy; no online update.
methods.full_policy: Reward update of prefix and BC head; full-update cost/forgetting proxy.
methods.adapter: Low-rank residual on globally pooled frozen-prefix features.
methods.reward_attention: Two trainable visual anchors and residual head, trained only from scalar task reward plus source distillation.
methods.supervised_anchors: Reward-attention policy plus training-only identity-free proposal supervision.
methods.anchors_cached: Same supervised anchor pathway with frozen-prefix tokens cached for replay learner updates.

claims.scope: Synthetic 1-D visual-strip contextual-bandit mechanism test; not a GRAFT reproduction or robot/VLA result.
